[[File:The_Buzz.png|thumb|right|The Buzz]]
'''The Buzz''' was a self-replenishing [[Stimulant/Legends|stim]] developed by the genius biochemist [[Tellak Skrep]]. A sample of it was recovered by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soldier [[Orm Kreg]], however he was mauled to death by a [[Tineback]] known as [[The Scrabbler]], who also ate the sample. The sample was recovered by the [[Alliance Commander]], who went on to manufacture more of it.<ref name="RelicHunt">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Relic Hunt: Self-Replenishing Stim|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>
